body.content: Unresolved tension: SRC_005 (thermal mass), SRC_006 (evapotranspiration), SRC_007 (anthropogenic heat), and SRC_008 (wind/geometry) each claim primacy. The question asks for a single mechanism for cross-city variation. But if the cross-city modulator is sky view factor (a geometric property) while the base warming is thermal mass (a material property), then the single best answer depends on whether the question means 'why is the base gap there at all' or 'why does it vary across cities.'
body.why_keep_this: Clarifies an ambiguity in the problem statement and suggests the answer may require distinguishing 'existence' from 'variation' explanations.
